weak-acid-titration-curve.alt: Titration curve for 25.00 mL of 0.100 M weak acid (Ka = 1.8 × 10⁻⁵) with 0.100 M NaOH. pH starts at 2.88, rises slowly through the shaded buffer region, equals pKa 4.74 at the half-equivalence point (12.50 mL), jumps steeply to the equivalence point at 25.00 mL (pH 8.72, above 7) and levels off near 12.5 with excess hydroxide.
